retrievalProfile.description: A low-angle group portrait set in a field of tall, dry grass featuring bold, interlocking psychedelic script in the upper third.
excludeWhen: urban or industrial settings are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A group of people positioned at varying depths within a dense field of tall, golden-brown grass, captured from a low perspective. The composition is topped by a large, stylized title in a vibrant lime-green psychedelic script with a dark outline, accompanied by smaller white sans-serif text blocks.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground grass blades obscuring and framing the subjects
High-contrast lime green title against a muted natural background
Low-angle perspective creating a sense of stature for the subjects
Triangular arrangement of subjects within the field
coreInvariants: Dense texture of dry grass in the foreground
Interlocking letterforms in the main title
Warm, desaturated color palette for the photography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are distributed across the lower two-thirds of the frame, appearing at medium-long to medium-close scales.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, vibrant green script title at the top center-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright title, move down through the central figure in yellow, then scan the surrounding members framed by grass.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with the texture of the grass and the subjects.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic elements (text) contrasted with the muted, earthy tones of the photographic base.

letterConstructionRules: Thick, fluid strokes with rounded terminals
Tight kerning with no visible gaps between main title letters
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' and 'y' are elongated to cradle adjacent letters
The 't' crossbars merge into the body of the next letter
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Vibrant, organic display script paired with functional, geometric sans-serif for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the secondary informational text style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle photograph of a group of four men in 1970s attire (yellow and orange shirts) sitting in a dense field of tall, dry, golden-brown grass. The grass should partially obscure the subjects in the foreground. Use a warm, vintage film aesthetic with soft grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, lime-green psychedelic script title at the top. The letters should be thick, interlocking, and have a dark green outline. Below it, add three lines of small, white, bold sans-serif text centered.

verificationChecks: Is the grass texture prominent in the foreground?
Is the color palette dominated by earth tones and lime green?

adjustableVariables: Saturation of the lime green text
mustRedesign: Avoid specific band names or song titles
Do not replicate the exact faces of the individuals
Ensure the script is a unique creation following the psychedelic rules
postGenerationChecks: Check for interlocking letterforms in the display text
Ensure subjects look integrated into the grass environment
Confirm the absence of modern technology or fashion
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Group Portrait + Tall Grass Framing + Psychedelic Script Overlay
